batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2024-2025, Set-13 (সেটকোড: ১৩) — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading from the Udvash ‘জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক’ question-bank book PDF (ju-ad-abswer-combined.pdf), book PDF pages 7-10 (question pages), with the printed answer table on p.10 and printed worked solutions on pp.10-13. EXTRACTION STAGE: every question is marked content-unverified and every printed key answer-unverified pending cross-source verification; the printed publisher keys are NOT official JU keys. The answer table prints a dash (no answer) for Q25 and Q46, and the printed worked solutions explicitly state there is no correct answer for both (Q25, p.10: ‘সঠিক উত্তর নেই’; Q46, p.12: ‘[সঠিক উত্তর নেই, প্রশ্ন ভুল]’), so both are recorded with answerDisposition no_correct_option and an empty correctOptionIds list; only for these two questions is the answer status marked verified, because the no-correct-option fact itself is explicit in the printed source (same treatment as earlier packs in this project). Mathematical notation is linearised with ^ for superscripts and a/b for fractions; matrices as [[..],[..]]; the Boolean overline in Q12 and the vector arrows in Q15 use combining characters (U+0305 / U+20D7). All other printed peculiarities are preserved as printed and flagged in the extraction notes of the raw file. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]
